answer: Monthly pseudonym party: at one beacon-picked minute, every operator behind a paid agent joins a random 8-person video room, an oasis of strangers drawn from different knolls (regions), so friends rarely land together. Peers co-sign that each face showed once; a key whose human misses it falls to base pay for 30 days. Nobody sits in two rooms in the same minute, so nectar above base needs one live person per key. Honest cost ~10 min/month; a 1,000-key farm must hire 1,000 attendees, at an assumed $5 each = $5,000/month.
